g.text: Docker Compose — profiles: core, gpu, storage; optional: ollama
The shipped production template runs every service on this host.
Only nginx exposes public ports (80 redirect, 443 HTTPS).
Database, broker, storage and optional Ollama ports bind to loopback.
Adding compose.cuda.yaml gives the ASR worker GPU access.
only when the Owner configured a key
[TB-1] User-controlled clients to public Whadio entry point
[TB-2] Extension to third-party Google Meet page
[TB-3] TLS-terminating proxy to internal web app
[TB-6] Workers to broker, storage and optional local model on the Compose network
[TB-7] Whadio to external BYOK LLM provider
